luamade.script:
local function check(c, m) if not c then print("FAIL " .. m) error(m) end end
local p = console.getBlock().getPos()
local function at(dx, dy, dz) return vec3i(p.getX() + dx, p.getY() + dy, p.getZ() + dz) end

check(fs.makeDir("/home/wt/sub"), "makeDir")
check(fs.isDir("/home/wt/sub"), "isDir")
check(fs.write("/home/wt/a.txt", "hello"), "write")
check(fs.read("/home/wt/a.txt") == "hello", "read")
fs.touch("/home/wt/a.txt")
check(fs.read("/home/wt/a.txt") == "hello", "touch keeps content")
local names = {}
for _, n in ipairs(fs.list("/home/wt")) do names[n] = true end
check(names["a.txt"] and names["sub"], "list")
check(fs.normalizePath("/home/wt/sub/../a.txt") == "/home/wt/a.txt", "normalizePath")
check(not fs.delete("/home/wt"), "delete non-empty dir refused")

check(fs.protect("/home/wt", "pw", "write"), "protect")
check(not fs.write("/home/wt/a.txt", "x"), "protected write denied")
check(fs.auth("pw"), "auth")
check(fs.write("/home/wt/a.txt", "x"), "authed write")
check(fs.unprotect("/home/wt", "pw"), "unprotect")
fs.clearAuth()

check(fs.delete("/home/wt/a.txt") and fs.delete("/home/wt/sub") and fs.delete("/home/wt"), "cleanup")
check(not fs.exists("/home/wt"), "deleted")
print("PASS filesystem")
